front: What did the Law of Suspects of 17 September 1793 allow?
back: The arrest of anyone suspected of hostility to the Revolution.

front: Why did the Terror continue after the victories of 1794?
back: Historians point to ideology and factional fear as well as emergency; the Great Terror followed the Law of 22 Prairial.
Killings of Jacobins and sympathisers by royalists and others in 1795, especially in the south-east.

front: Why did the Directory fall in 1799?
back: It had little popular support, relied on coups and the army, suffered defeats in 1799 and was overthrown by Bonaparte on 18 Brumaire.
